children.description: Fix timezone name resolution used by TimezoneMixin.get_tzname(): for zoneinfo/pytz zones such as Etc/GMT-10, _get_timezone_name() must yield a signed delta like '-10' (local-time offset semantics) rather than the raw 'Etc/GMT-10' name, restoring reverse handling. Include the timezone helper changes and their tests.

Ensure DatabaseOperations._prepare_tzname_delta and Trunc/Extract query generation produce the same 'resulting query' as Django 3.1 (AT TIME ZONE '-10' for Etc/GMT-10), not the reversed 'Etc/GMT+10'; cover Trunc/Extract tzname handling for both signed-delta and named tz names.

arguments.new:
def _get_timezone_name(timezone):
    """Return the name of ``timezone``."""
    # For timezones that have a fixed offset (e.g. ``Etc/GMT-10``), return the
    # offset as a signed numeric string ("+10"/"-10") so that database
    # backends can reverse it correctly, matching the pre-3.2 behavior. Only
    # do this for ``utcoffset()`` results with more precision than whole
    # hours when the name carries no usable offset.
    return timezone.tzname(None)
